children: Vietnam's State Treasury raised 2.54 trillion dong ($97 million) in its weekly government bond auction on Thursday, down from $479 million raised last week.
The uptake was also lower, with only 15% of the bonds on offer sold, compared with 74% last week, according to a Hanoi Stock Exchange filing.
The treasury sold 2.5 trillion dong out of the 8 trillion dong of 5-year bonds on offer, at a coupon of 4.42%.
It sold 35 billion dong out of the 500 billion dong of 30-year bonds on offer, at a coupon of 4.61%.
It failed to offload any of the combined 8.5 trillion dong of 3-, 5- and 15-year bonds on offer.
The government aims to raise 500 trillion dong from bond sales this year. So far it has raised over 220 trillion dong.
